name: photoscribe-ai
description: CareFrame: a private hospital media workspace with semantic photo search, staff uploads, human review, and consent/usage-rights controls. AWS serverless, React, Terraform, Cloudflare Pages.

paragraphs: PhotoScribe AI powers CareFrame, a private hospital media workspace for finding, reviewing, and reusing photos with clear consent and usage-rights context. Images stay in private Amazon S3 storage; Bedrock descriptions and embeddings support semantic search through S3 Vectors. Cognito, DynamoDB asset policies, and short-lived signed image links govern access.
The interface uses Briar University Hospital, a fictional organization. Public photographs are illustrative, not customer assets or endorsements.
features: an AWS ingest pipeline that reacts to S3 uploads and creates AI-generated photo metadata
an ingest-time WebP thumbnail pipeline for faster UI previews while originals remain private
a vector search backend using Bedrock embeddings and S3 Vectors
an HTTP search API backed by AWS Lambda and API Gateway
a responsive React interface with Cognito login, metadata filters, browser uploads, review queue, and signed image previews

requirements.text: The staff workspace opens at sign-in, with no private results or search controls exposed beforehand.
Search results, filters, signed image links, uploads, review queues, and admin actions stay behind staff sign-in.
Upload and review tools require staff access because image ingest triggers real AWS processing cost.
The recipient must click Confirm subscription before billing and operational alarm emails can be delivered.
